connector.name: FutureProof AEO
connector.registryDescription: Track brand visibility across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini & Perplexity. Scores, competitors, trends.
connector.summary: Hosted at ai.futureproof.work over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mattyb12345nyc account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token in the form `Bearer fp_live_<64-hex>`. Get an API key for free at https://ai.futureproof.work/settings/api-keys. A no-signup free tier (5 calls/day, 15 questions/day per IP) is also available at https://ai.futureproof.work/.netlify/functions/mcp-free.
